Theorem
[Gromov proportionality for hyperbolic manifolds] \group smearing ↗ thurston-ch06-measure-chains ↗ thurston-ch06-smearing ↗ thurston-ch06-hyperbolic-norm-lower-bound Source: thurston:page-0140, thurston:page-0141

For every closed oriented hyperbolic $n$-manifold, \[ \| [M]\| =\frac{v(M)}{v_n}. \]

Proof

\sketch The lower bound is the differential-form estimate. For a straight simplex $\sigma $ and its reflected copy $\sigma _-$, the cycle $\frac12\operatorname {smear}_M(\sigma -\sigma _-)$ has norm $v(M)$ and integrates the volume form to $v(M)v(\sigma )$, hence represents $v(\sigma )[M]$. Divide by $v(\sigma )$ and take simplices with volumes approaching $v_n$.

□
